{{Quote|Hokey religions and ancient weapons are no match for a good blaster at your side, kid.|Han Solo|<ref name="Episode IV" />}}
'''Han's heavy blaster pistol''' was a modified [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]] [[DL-44 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|DL-44 heavy blaster pistol]].<ref name="CCG-Han" /> Han once claimed the [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] had been a gift from [[Jaina (Elder)|his mother]].<ref name="SW Annual 2">[[Star Wars Annual (1977) 2|''Star Wars Annual'' (1977) 2]]</ref> Solo modified the weapon, adding a [[Scope/Legends|scope]] with integrated [[Motion sensor/Legends|motion sensor]] software and [[Computer/Legends|computer]]-enhanced low-light sighting. The weapon's [[Galven circuit/Legends|galven circuitry]] was improved, allowing the blaster to fire more powerful blaster bolts without draining additional power.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> However, the weapon was mainly effective at short range, and only carried enough energy for twenty-five shots.<ref name="CCG-Han" /> The weapon was kept in a [[quickdraw holster]] at Solo's hip, giving the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] an edge when speed counted.<ref name="EGWT" />
